gen-gf-tektur-gf-julius-sans-one: Tektur arrives expressive and oddly proportioned, with outsized lowercase and open-ended curves. Julius Sans One follows in a plain sans, hushed and widely spaced, giving that loud heading plenty of white space to breathe against.
gen-flavors-bitter: Bitter brings a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and see-through s shapes. Bitter's steady footing gives Flavors room to be whimsical, since its towering, contrast-free strokes carry all the swagger.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads wide and flat, its words spaced out like stepping stones. Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes and big x-height sit above that plain sans, loud where the body is level-headed.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-lexend-mega: Commanding is how Wallpoet looks, its tall lowercase and stenciled breaks built to announce. Lexend Mega does the opposite job in sans form, tracing every letter with one nib so lines of text move along smoothly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads big and friendly, with wide-mouthed c shapes and a generous x-height. Warnes, with tapered ink strokes and stretched spacing, can go larger than this sans-serif body, so give it a bigger size.
gen-irish-grover-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta runs wide and ribbon-flat, its tall-bodied small letters spread across the line. Irish Grover plays against that sans-serif with sturdy, softly tapered lowercase, so the two feel like a loose joke and a straight answer.
gen-flavors-roboto-slab: Whimsical Flavors towers on its tall lowercase, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Roboto Slab behind it is a tidier slab-serif, so the heading can be a few sizes bigger without crowding it.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-lexend-exa: Luckiest Guy has a mean, high-set line and ink that looks poured at one width, loud and cheerful at once. And Lexend Exa, a plain sans with wide curves and stubby ascenders, answers that noise with a level, businesslike hush.
gen-megrim-gf-julius-sans-one: Megrim's angular, measured strokes feel like a futuristic blueprint. Julius Sans One carries that mood into longer reading, its sans-serif letters spaced wide so the text drifts along lightly and quietly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga is flat, wide and modern, with sturdy single-weight lines and plenty of tracking. But Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, opens its curves like jaws above that sans-serif, so a bigger heading size lets its character show.
